# Jito Bridge — Bridge Assets to Solana for Jito Reference

> Move assets from Ethereum to Solana so you can stake with Jito (jitoSOL liquid staking) and use its MEV infrastructure, non-custodially.

## Key Facts
- Action: bridge assets from another chain (usually Ethereum) to Solana, then use Jito on Solana
- Jito: Solana liquid staking (issues jitoSOL) + MEV infrastructure — it is a Solana protocol, so you bridge to Solana first
- jitoSOL: liquid staking token representing staked SOL plus staking/MEV rewards, usable across Solana DeFi
- Gas: Solana network fees are paid in SOL — keep a small SOL balance to transact and stake
- Custody: non-custodial — your wallet signs each step
- Costs: source-chain gas + bridge fee + Solana fees (SOL)
